title: Bean stuffed peppers
summary: Bean stuffed peppers is a mexican dinner built around red peppers and canned pinto beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Bean stuffed peppers into even pieces and toss canned pinto beans with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of canned pinto beans while you season red peppers. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle red peppers and basmati rice among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Bean stuffed peppers before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Bean stuffed peppers into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
